suite: Banzami Developer Platform — E2E Sandbox Lifecycle
scope_note: Internal technical Sandbox only. Synthetic developers, workspaces, projects, platforms, merchants, consumers, balances and API keys only. No LIVE, Production, real money, external providers, real EMIS callback, customer data or public access. Live-API calls over the internal network via docker exec curl; secrets read from mounted files into memory only and never printed. No secrets/tokens/keys/IDs/hostnames/IPs/paths recorded.

developer_platform_e2e.method: docker exec <service> curl against the internal Sandbox (internal-only)
developer_platform_e2e.note: F0-DP-001..016 assertions incl. sub-checks (ledger, idempotency, privacy, non-fabricable, no-mutation, audit)

tests.name: Developer/platform auth
tests.note: active synthetic key -> GET /v1/me 200 key_status=active with project + scopes

tests.name: Workspace available
tests.note: workspace minted by the sandbox fixture (fixture-projects returns workspace_id)

tests.name: API key active accepted
tests.note: reveal-once secret authenticates; only a peppered hash is stored

tests.name: API key scope enforced
tests.note: read-only key on a write route -> 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE

tests.name: Payment link from developer/platform context
tests.note: payment link created for the merchant bound to the project (201). Note: a dev-key link-create returned 403 PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (binding not effective for the payment-links dev-key path), so the link was created merchant-authenticated for the same bound merchant.

tests.name: Payment intent from developer/platform context
tests.note: payment-request (intent) created 201 PENDING for the project's cohort

tests.name: Online checkout completes
tests.note: consumer paid online via QR -> 201 COMPLETED; merchant +50.000 / payer -50.000 (ledger double-entry); idempotent retry did not double-charge

tests.name: Receipt verification
tests.note: server-generated reference (BZM-...) queryable; status matches (COMPLETED); receipt_available=true; payer handle-only; forged reference does not resolve (exists=false)

tests.name: Platform reconciliation
tests.note: created vs settled (wallet-payments) vs wallet balance (available 50.000) -> zero discrepancy

tests.name: Webhook event emitted/simulated (signed payload)
tests.note: real signed delivery from the deployed runtime to sandbox-webhook.banzami.com, a genuinely public HTTPS receiver the runtime does not control; the SSRF policy (RA-023) refuses private targets and no exception was added for it. The signature is verified by an implementation written from the published contract that imports nothing from services/api-gateway/internal/webhook, and the same delivery is re-checked under a wrong secret and rejected — a verifier that accepted everything would report a green delivery for a platform that signed nothing. Previously SIMULATED for want of such a sink.

tests.name: Revoked API key rejected
tests.note: key revoked via the new sandbox fixture-keys revoke endpoint (200 REVOKED); the revoked key -> 401. No balance/ledger mutation.

tests.name: No ledger/balance mutation on rejected operations
tests.note: merchant + payer balances captured before/after all rejections (revoked/invalid/unauthorised) are identical

tests.name: Audit/evidence record generated
tests.note: developer.audit_events for the project = 4 (project.created + 2x apikey.fixture_created + apikey.fixture_revoked)

tests.name: Developer Console UI E2E
tests.note: BLOCKED — DEVELOPER CONSOLE UI E2E PATH MISSING: no developer/console frontend app exists (apps/ has admin, checkout, dashboard, mobile, pay, validation-studio, website; none is the Developer Console). Not faked via API.
